name: Scribbr
tagline: Scribbr offers a suite of AI tools for academic writing including a citation generator supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard styles, a paraphrasing tool, a grammar checker, and a plagiarism checker. It is trusted by millions of students worldwide for producing publication-quality academic work.
